## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and its motivation.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run privacy:check`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Native build completed when applicable
- [ ] Tests, fixtures, screenshots, and logs contain synthetic data only
- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, names, emails, or local stores are included
